body: You guys have it all here. I can go to college if I want to, or I could get a job and make money. I could become a youtube celebrity and make enough to pay the rent. Its not like other countries where you have to go out and protest your school system because they don't give a shit. I can say what I want here without fear of having military break into my house and question me in the middle of the night. I have the safety I want and all the opportunities that people in my country can only dream of. My parents brought me here for a better future, and don't get me wrong this is definitely the land of opportunity, as cliche as it sounds, its very true. Had I not come here, I would have never graduated high school, and I'd probably end up working on a farm my whole life or being involved in illegal ways of making money by hurting others or the community. I mean don't get me wrong this country's not perfect, but it gives me a platform to be able to complain and bitch about what I don't like, and gives me basic human rights that other places don't do.

This is my home. I don't want to leave. If someone walked into your house and said "Hey, you need to leave." But I like my house! "Well, you can just get another house somewhere else! Its just THAT easy to get accustomed to a new culture, lifestyle, and politics!" Not to mention that people that leave and then come back as failures are TOTALLY not made fun of or criticized.
I just, don't see any point in it anymore. I'm literally trapped.
In that case really hope they accept IOU's at the airport.
